verdict.stance: Constructive / Flagship Uzbek State Policy & Commercial Bank (BB/BB)
verdict.summary: Uzbekistan's #1 bank by assets (UZS 146.5tn / ~$12.1bn, ~15% market share) and profit (UZS 1.92tn FY25; Q126 +28.9% YoY). Equalized at BB Stable by both Fitch and S&P on extremely high state support, with superior asset quality vs SOE peers (NPLs 3.3-3.7%) and clean $600m USD Eurobond ladder (2029/2030).

positives: Flagship ~15% banking system share (UZS 146.5tn assets) with sovereign-equalized BB ratings at Fitch & S&P.
Sector-leading profitability (UZS 1.92tn FY25 NPAT; Q126 +28.9% YoY) and improving 3.3-3.7% NPL ratio.
No near-term USD Eurobond maturities until 2029 ($300m) and 2030 ($300m).
negatives: High exposure to state-owned enterprise (SOE) directed lending and FX loan dollarization.
Standalone Viability Rating (Fitch b+) sits two notches below sovereign support.
Thinning ROE (~12% projected 2026-27) amid rising deposit competition and retail expansion capex.

background.business_overview: Uzbekistan's largest state-owned universal commercial bank, acting as primary financial agent for strategic SOEs and infrastructure.
background.asset_perimeter: Corporate/SOE lending, SME, retail banking, treasury across Uzbekistan.
